question: On 12 January 2022, the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully conducted the qualification test of the Cryogenic Engine for the Gaganyaan programme for a duration of 720 seconds at the ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendragiri,Tamil Nadu**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On January 12, 2022, the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully conducted a 720-second qualification test of the cryogenic engine for the Gaganyaan program at the ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu.
 
• The test was a major milestone for the Gaganyaan Human Space Programme.
 
• The test ensured the reliability and robustness of the cryogenic engine for the human-rated launch vehicle. 
 
• **Cryogenic Engines: The Powerhouse of Space Exploration**
 
 
• Cryogenic engines are essential for launching spacecraft into higher orbits or beyond Earth's gravity.
 
• They use extremely cold propellants, such as liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen, which provide a significant boost in thrust.
 
• The Gaganyaan program, India's ambitious mission to send humans into space, requires a powerful cryogenic engine to propel the spacecraft into orbit.
